craft_notes: Sthāyin: gladness as place (owner reviews first-verse of chapter). Sanskrit-first: parameśvarasamāveśayogya held whole. Rows: mark then cause. Rejected: naming other marks — killed: none admitted. Read aloud: opening decree.

lines: Now the glad-hearted should wend to the worship-ground —
where the heart grows glad, fit for the Lord's embrace,
that alone the mark, and naught besides;
for e'en as told, the thought one with the thought is cause,
and that from gladness alone — no other ground.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atha prasannahṛdayo yāgasthānaṃ yāyāt tac ca yatraiva hṛdayaṃ prasādayuktaṃ parameśvarasamāveśayogyaṃ bhavati tad eva na tu asya anyal lakṣaṇam uktāv api dhyeyatādātmyam eva kāraṇam tad api bhāvaprasādād eva iti nānyat sthānam
